create_DictBuffer: create a DictBuffer with a fixed capacity to store and sample dictionary data as PyTorch tensors
extend_DictBuffer: extend a DictBuffer by adding batched dictionary data that wraps around when capacity is reached
sample_TrajectoryBuffer: sample trajectory sequences from a TrajectoryBuffer using priority-weighted episode selection and random time indices
update_priorities_TrajectoryBuffer: update the sampling priorities of a TrajectoryBuffer for priority experience replay
convert_numpy_to_torch: convert numpy arrays and numbers to PyTorch tensors with optional device placement using _to_torch
